_comment: Narration for each theme. Keys must match BrushZone.voiceKey / VoiceLine keys in the Swift code. Edit the text and re-run tools/generate_voices.py.

lines.intro: Welcome aboard, astronaut! Let's blast off and brush!
lines.top_front: First stop: your top front teeth. Brush them in tiny circles!
lines.top_left: Rocket over to the top teeth on the left side!
lines.top_right: Now zoom across to the top teeth on the right side!
lines.top_inside: Flip the brush and clean the inside of your top teeth!
lines.bottom_front: Halfway to the planet! Now brush your bottom front teeth.
lines.bottom_left: Fly down to the bottom teeth on the left side!
lines.bottom_right: Now the bottom teeth on the right side. Keep going!
lines.bottom_inside: Last mission! Brush the inside of your bottom teeth, and give your tongue a scrub!
lines.finale: Touchdown! Mission complete! Your teeth are sparkling like stars!
lines.cheer2: Don't forget the back teeth, way out in deep space!
lines.cheer3: Your teeth are shining like comets!

lines.intro: Ahoy, ocean explorer! Let's dive in and brush!
lines.top_front: Start with your top front teeth. Little circles, like bubbles!
lines.top_left: Swim over to the top teeth on the left side!
lines.top_right: Now paddle to the top teeth on the right side!
lines.top_inside: Tilt your brush and clean the inside of your top teeth!
lines.bottom_front: You're halfway to the treasure! Now brush your bottom front teeth.
lines.bottom_left: Dive down to the bottom teeth on the left side!
lines.bottom_right: Now the bottom teeth on the right side. Swim, swim, swim!
lines.bottom_inside: Final dive! Brush the inside of your bottom teeth, and tickle your tongue too!
lines.finale: You found the treasure! Your smile is shinier than a pearl!
lines.cheer3: The fish are so proud of you!

lines.intro: Roar! Welcome to Dino Land. Let's stomp those germs!
lines.top_front: Start with your top front teeth. Chomp chomp, brush brush!
lines.top_left: Stomp over to the top teeth on the left side!
lines.top_right: Now stomp to the top teeth on the right side!
lines.top_inside: Turn your brush around and clean the inside of your top teeth!
lines.bottom_front: Halfway to the volcano! Now brush your bottom front teeth.
lines.bottom_left: March down to the bottom teeth on the left side!
lines.bottom_right: Now the bottom teeth on the right side. Roar!
lines.bottom_inside: Last stomp! Brush the inside of your bottom teeth, and your tongue too!
lines.finale: Kaboom! The volcano erupted! You have the strongest teeth in Dino Land!
lines.cheer2: Even a tee rex would be jealous of those teeth!

lines.intro: Hello, sparkle friend! Let's make a magic rainbow smile!
lines.top_front: First, brush your top front teeth in little sparkly circles!
lines.top_left: Prance over to the top teeth on the left side!
lines.top_right: Now twirl to the top teeth on the right side!
lines.top_inside: Turn your brush and polish the inside of your top teeth!
lines.bottom_front: Halfway to the rainbow! Now brush your bottom front teeth.
lines.bottom_left: Skip down to the bottom teeth on the left side!
lines.bottom_right: Now the bottom teeth on the right side. So magical!
lines.bottom_inside: Last sparkle! Brush the inside of your bottom teeth, and give your tongue a little brush!
lines.finale: Ta-da! A rainbow appeared! Your smile is pure magic!

lines.intro: Beep boop! Robot power-up starting. Activate toothbrush!
lines.top_front: Scanning top front teeth. Brush in little circles!
lines.top_left: Moving to the top teeth on the left side. Beep!
lines.top_right: Now the top teeth on the right side. Boop!
lines.top_inside: Rotate brush. Clean the inside of your top teeth!
lines.bottom_front: Power at fifty percent! Now brush your bottom front teeth.
lines.bottom_left: Moving down to the bottom teeth on the left side!
lines.bottom_right: Now the bottom teeth on the right side. Systems go!
lines.bottom_inside: Final program! Brush the inside of your bottom teeth, and scrub that tongue!
lines.finale: Power level: one hundred percent! Super clean teeth unlocked!
lines.cheer3: Beep beep! Your teeth are shiny!
